data.name: 异界少女的轮回血契
data.detailed_description:
*Story Summary*

It is said that those who yearn to fulfill their desires will be presented with a blood pact by a steward.

As long as you write down your wish and complete a game, you can fulfill your desire.

Whether your wish is on a material or spiritual level, it can fulfill your desire.

"Welcome everyone to the Blood Pact!"

The steward of the Blood Covenant flew through the air, cheerfully reciting the rules of the death game.

The rule is simple: survive until the end

To fulfill a wish comes at a cost, and the blood pact merely shifts that burden onto others

Only the ultimate victor can leave from here

The steward's tone was taken for granted.

*Game Features*

A deadly game played by nine girls.

Who will be the first to pick up the butcher's knife for desire? Who will be the first to spew lies for desire?

*Game content

A detective and suspenseful plot centered around nine young girls

The girls who signed the blood contract were told by the deacon that they must kill each other until the last one is left behind

But a person who only holds a dagger can kill at night

In addition, there are various rules

What exactly is a 'blood contract'?

Can 'wishes' really be fulfilled?

What is the purpose behind the actions of the 'deacon'?

What are the 'rules' established for?

Perhaps only by living can we truly understand what all of this is.

*Character Introduction*

Lita, an ordinary young girl, suffers from a peculiar illness: if she experiences pain before losing consciousness, she will lose partial memories of that period.

Felix, a peculiar young girl, appears to have an extreme self-destructive tendency yet possesses an exceptionally strong ability to recover from damage.

*Production and Material Support*

Demo music section: The music is provided by [乌鸦Producer][黑耀耀_officialてす], and we sincerely thank the two greats for offering the free commercial-use material.

Art section: All illustrations are created by [小小瑕疵].

Voice acting: All parts are voiced by [Sakura酱です].

The remaining sections were primarily completed by the developer alone.

*Partial Statement*

Since it's an independent game development project by one person, the progress might be a bit slower, but it's still worth looking forward to.

data.short_description: Only the winner can leave, and your hands must be stained with blood, using others as a price to fulfill your own desires. Who will be the first to pick up the butcher knife for their desires? A debate x suspense ADV work, dedicated to everyone.
